paragraphs: ## ⏸️ Public commits are currently paused — but NetLock RMM is actively developed Development has not stopped — quite the opposite. NetLock RMM is being actively built and shipped every day; we have simply paused public commits to this repository while we curate what we publish under our open-core model. New releases, features and fixes keep coming. This decision follows repeated license violations — startups copying the project and using AI to re-implement it to sidestep the AGPL. Read the full background in our 🔓 Open Core statement below and the founder's story.

Security: Please do not use AI tools or other methods to analyze the security of the code published in our GitHub repositories or report potential vulnerabilities based on it. Our closed source release has evolved significantly beyond the now outdated GitHub codebase, which represents an early prototype of NetLock RMM and no longer reflects the current product's architecture or security posture. If you're interested in security research or penetration testing, we welcome you to deploy NetLock RMM through our Members Portal on your own self hosted server and test it as extensively as you like.…
⭐ If NetLock RMM is useful to you, please star this repo — it helps others discover the project!
features: 350+ ready-made sensors • 85+ features • 100+ granular permissions • 53 report templates • 9 console languages • 3 platforms • 0 hidden telemetry
Looking for the full feature list? Head over to netlockrmm.com/docs/features.
